data_provenance.source: NYSE/NASDAQ published holiday & early-close schedule, derived offline from standard NYSE rules (fixed + floating holidays, weekend-observance shifts, day-after-Thanksgiving / Christmas-Eve early closes)
data_provenance.note: Rules-derived OFFLINE (no provider/network, SR-PROVIDER-001). Dates — ESPECIALLY weekend-observance shifts (2026 Jul-4->Fri Jul-3; 2027 Juneteenth->Fri Jun-18, Jul-4->Mon Jul-5, Christmas->Fri Dec-24) and the early-close list — MUST be cross-checked against the official NYSE calendar before any live/forward use (batch5). Bounded to 2026-2027; extend + re-verify before expiry (see us_short_system_design.md §13 follow-up). 2026 Jul-3 and 2027 Dec-24 are observed FULL closes (in holidays), so they are intentionally NOT also early-close half-days.
